title: Nymphes des bois / Requiem (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Nymphes des bois / Requiem. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Quinta pars, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Benthem, "Masses and Mass Sections -- Okeghem"; Smijers; Medici Codex ed.. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2918); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
